title: Module for_each
scenario: Instantiate the same module once per environment using for_each over a map.

focus.title: Complete the for_each module call
focus.todo: Instantiate the module once per environment with for_each.

hints.why: Modules package a group of resources behind a small input/output contract. They turn copy-pasted infrastructure into something a team can version, review and reuse.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `module "this"`. Instantiate the module once per environment with for_each. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Use a module when the same group of resources appears more than once, when a team needs a supported interface, or when you want to test a component independently.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `module "this"`. Use this code shape: source; for_each; bucket_name; environment. Use the already-declared references instead of hardcoded values: `each.key`, `each.value`. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
